slides.title: Ten minutes. *No input.*
slides.sub: What do you hear when nothing else is talking?

slides.title: Notice the reach
slides.body: Most quiet moments get filled before we notice them. A feed, a podcast, the radio. Watch for the reach.

slides.title: Sit with nothing on
slides.body: Ten minutes. No phone, no music, no podcast. Not meditating, just not filling the space.

slides.title: See what shows up
slides.body: A worry, a name, a conversation you've put off. Don't fix it. Just notice what's been waiting.

slides.title: What surfaced?
slides.body: Write down the first thing that came up. Then ask: what have I been using the noise to avoid?
